trips.label: Lonavala
trips.route_note: Direct suburban and express trains run from Mumbai's CSMT and Dadar stations to Lonavala, with local taxis for the hill viewpoints.
trips.why: Direct trains from Dadar reach Lonavala in 2 hours, faster than the bus and right by the town.
know: Book express train seats ahead, especially for weekends
The monsoon (June-September) is the classic season for the hill views and waterfalls
Local taxis are needed to reach the viewpoints from the station

trips.label: Alibaug
trips.route_note: Take a ferry from the Gateway of India or a bus/train via Panvel, then a short road transfer into Alibaug town.
trips.why: The bus runs in under 3 hours and drops you in Alibaug town, while the ferry route needs a road transfer at the far end.
know: Ferries from the Gateway of India are the scenic alternative but depend on sea conditions
Weekends get crowded, so go on a weekday if you can
The beaches and forts are spread out, so expect local transport once there
